article.title: Mega-scale experimental analysis of protein folding stability in biology and design

source.reliability_note: The paper supplement states that impossible protease-specific delta-G estimates receive dummy values and labels 95% confidence intervals wider than 0.5 kcal/mol as lower confidence. Every retained raw replicate has finite non-dummy trypsin/chymotrypsin delta-G and all combined and protease-specific interval widths at or below 0.5 kcal/mol.
